title: Short-answer ledger
summary: Section 12 of the Quiet Ledger is a Büro FAQ ledger hung from the Index Spine on paper. Every row puts its straight answer in its own column ('Infrastructure you own.', 'Ten working days.', 'The system stays.'), so the section delivers its headline before anything is opened. Exactly one row opens in place, with the reasoning set large under the question and a ruled ledger of terms under the short answer. Today's version is a dark accordion that hides every answer behind a +.

reference.borrowed: A margin-to-margin indexed ledger. A tiny 'FAQ' label sits alone in a narrow far-left column, and the heading hangs from the content column instead of the margin. The rows carry a numeric index at left and the question in the content column. The single open answer is set large in muted grey, so it reads as calm editorial copy rather than interface.
reference.kelwin: Büro's lone label column became B's spine column, holding only a light wide '12' and the red-square '■ FAQ'. The section hangs from the spine at a right-angle opening rule with the 6px joint square. The heading hangs where Büro's does, as B's 88px sentence plus a light muted sentence ('Straight answers. / Before the call.'), over the 48×2 red rule, with the lede as a side note in cols 10–12. Büro's '01.' became mono 'N·01', and a mono ledger head (QUESTION · THE SHORT ANSWER · 06) was added. The descriptor column holds each question's straight answer, lifted from the source copy. The two-hairline + rotates to −. The open answer is 20px --fg-2 under the question, and its terms are ruled under the short answer. The System Audit answer carries the red 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗', and a 'NEXT' foot row carries the contact door.

motion: entrance (≈2s, long and short-distance): the spine drops in from the top edge (400ms), the joint square appears, and the opening rule draws from the spine to the right margin (900ms --ease-out). The '12' index and label fade (400ms). The statement rises 12px (700ms) with the muted sentence 160ms behind, then the red rule draws (500ms) and the side lede rises. The ledger reveals top-down: the mono head fades, and each hairline draws from the spine (600ms, 60ms stagger) as its index, question, short answer and + fade in. The open row's answer and the foot row fade last.

state change (at 2.1s): the demo arrives with N·01 open, then the ledger hands over to N·02, the System Audit. Row 01 closes as row 02 opens (height + opacity 360ms --ease-inout), 02's + rotates to −, and its short answer lifts to --fg. Exactly one row is ever open.

interaction: rows are buttons with aria-expanded, one open at a time. A hovered row fills --panel and its question shifts 8px right (300ms). The audit button deepens to --accent-hover with ↗ moving 2px up-right, and the contact underline turns --fg.

on the live site: opening follows clicks and the auto-advance is demo-only. The resting state (markup and reduced motion) is N·02 open, so the red audit door is always on screen. The spine index is sticky and crossfades as sections pass.
notes: Every short answer and term is lifted from the source FAQ. The paragraphs are trimmed so nothing is said twice. The System Audit row carries the red door; the foot row the contact door. Coherence pass (direction B, one site): every section now shares one head — 64px light index + red-square caps label (Mona 500, 11px, .18em) in the spine column, 88px statement at weight 430 / −0.018em with exactly one light (300) muted sentence, the 48×2 red rule, 18/30 lede — at 48/44/32px offsets from a 6px joint, with 128px top and bottom padding (the live site keeps B's 200px). Mono captions are 11px at .18em; spine numerals drop tabular figures (Mona's tabular zero is slashed); quiet doors are 12px tracked caps with a drawn arrow. Here: padding 136/104 → 128/128, head offsets to 48/44, label 11px, mono heads at .18em, CTA 12px.
